data.rationale: The proposal follows the same flow (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, dates, passengers, Search, Fastest sort, See flight, Select, Next) and adds a "direct only" filter and a flexible-ticket choice that fit the true clicks, but it fixes some details the true workflow leaves open, and the origin, destination and date parameters are concrete enough to automate.
